what: Motorola Solutions supplies the radio systems emergency services use, along with the software, body cameras, licence plate readers and command-centre systems built around them. It is not the phone company of the same name.
customers: Police, fire and ambulance services, defence ministries, schools, hospitals and large enterprises in over 100 countries.
money: two-way radio networks, body cameras and video security hardware
command centre software, maintenance and subscription services
moat: Public safety radio networks are built once and kept for decades, and the agencies that use them cannot risk switching mid-service.
risks: Revenue depends on government budgets at national and local level
Axon competes aggressively in video and evidence management
Growth is steady but moderate in a mature radio market
Debt of about $11 billion was used partly for acquisitions
opportunities: Software and services revenue is recurring and grows faster than hardware
Video security and licence plate recognition extend it into new budgets
Return on invested capital near 19% supports continuing buybacks
watch: Software and services revenue growth and the size of the order backlog.
